notes: Delhi publishes no revocation, lapse or withdrawal list and the register has no status column, so `revoked` is null and blocked is always empty. atForm answers from the day's bulk read (sharedRead), not a per-number request. To prove `down`, point RERA_DL_FIXTURES at the `down` subfolder (both reads marked .down) and call resetPortalCache() first. `ours` is on the register valid to 31-Dec-2098 and on the extensions list extended to 30-Jun-2099, so its validTo must read 2099-06-30 (the later of the two). Real rows kept: company promoters only.
